name: Spacing Scale Generator
description: Generates a modular spacing scale (in px and rem) from a base unit and a ratio.

tools.name: generate_spacing_scale
tools.description: Generates a modular spacing scale in px and rem from a base unit, step count, and ratio.

baseUnitPx.description: Base spacing unit in px. Default 4.

steps.description: Number of steps in the scale. Default 8.
